::: {#def-ss-between}
#### Between-group sum of squares

Let $y_{j1}, \ldots, y_{jn_j}$ be the $n_j$ observations in group $j$,
for $k \ge 2$ groups with $n \eqdef \sum_{j=1}^k n_j$ observations in all,
let $\bar{y}_j$ be the sample mean of group $j$,
and let $\bar{y}$ be the sample mean of all $n$ observations.
The **between-group sum of squares** is

$$\text{SS}_\text{between} \eqdef \sum_{j=1}^k n_j (\bar{y}_j - \bar{y})^2.$$

:::
